maturity_time_before_deposit.meaning: maturityTime[user] value before the deposit, which the report states is never set and retains its default of 0

rewards_earned_without_lock.meaning: whether the user earned rewards by depositing and then withdrawing without satisfying the maturity lock

assumptions: The user deposits into GaugeV2 and then withdraws after a one-block wait, as described in the scenario.
The maturity lock is not satisfied at the time of withdrawal because maturityTime defaults to 0 and is never set.

unresolved.description: Report does not specify the reward amount or accrual formula, so the reward quantity itself cannot be bound; only the Boolean occurrence of earning rewards without the lock is represented.

limitations: The reward accrual mechanism and amounts are not formalized; the claim covers only the occurrence of earning rewards without satisfying the maturity lock.
The report does not establish whether the depositor is authorized or unauthorized; no permissionlessness claim is made.
